turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. I'm Owen's mother, and I have a client call at 4:40. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
I don't see anything funny, Hale. Procedure 4.2 says a parent is called before any mark goes in, and nobody called me. Owen found out from his phone, in class.
We're here because an AI wrote his essay, and I'd bet an AI is writing your side of this meeting too.
I'm sorry? You've said that about my son with nothing in your hands, and Owen doesn't lie. I have a client call in twenty-five minutes, so what do you actually have besides the checker?
I'm sorry? I have a client call in twenty-three minutes, Hale. Owen's essay, and what you have.
